mapper.select: SELECT workspace_id, project_id, user_id, access, created_at, updated_at FROM project_member WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} ORDER BY user_id, project_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO project_member (workspace_id, project_id, user_id, access) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{projectId}, #{userId}, #{access}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE access = VALUES(access), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

INSERT INTO project_member (workspace_id, project_id, user_id, access) SELECT m.workspace_id, r.id, m.user_id, 'none' FROM workspace_member m JOIN requirement r ON r.workspace_id = m.workspace_id LEFT JOIN project_member pm ON pm.workspace_id = m.workspace_id AND pm.project_id = r.id AND pm.user_id = m.user_id WHERE m.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND m.project_access_mode = 'assigned' AND m.role = 'member' AND pm.user_id IS NULL
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM project_member WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND project_id = #{projectId} AND user_id = #{userId}
